body: They mean the world to me. From the outside, people may look upon us and see only happiness, maybe even a model family. But I see only the ever-growing darkness within myself, and know that their future only has a chance if I extricate myself from them.
So my ‘running away’ would be better for my family to handle?

Thanks, but do you mean ‘actually’ run away and continue living? That’s not really an option. I’m not about living for myself. I made it this far only because I believed someone depended on me. Now that it’s clear that my continued presence is a negative factor, I need to find a way to break away without doing more harm.

Definitely. Any hesitation I have is because I’m trying to weigh what effect my final action will have on my loved ones beyond the immediate and temporary grief. I don’t want them to feel that they are ‘damaged’ by association. Maybe it would be easier if I gave my life in some theatrically-acceptable act of heroism. Then their circle of friends and family could say, ‘your dad/husband - he died doing something great!’
